comments.text:
There was a police check when we were here. The police was nice and asked the cars they stopped if they could take us to Coyhaique. 
Everyone said no, and the cars they didn't stop did not want to stop next to the police.
We walked 300 down the road and was picked up in 10 minutes
comments.textFr:
There was a police check when we were here. The police was nice and asked the cars they stopped if they could take us to Coyhaique. 
Everyone said no, and the cars they didn't stop did not want to stop next to the police.
We walked 300 down the road and was picked up in 10 minutes
comments.textEn:
There was a police check when we were here. The police were nice and asked the cars they stopped if they could take us to Coyhaique. 
Everyone said no, and the cars they didn't stop didn't want to stop next to the police.
We walked 300 down the road and was picked up in 10 minutes
comments.textEs:
Hubo un control policial cuando estuvimos aquí. La policía fue amable y preguntó a los autos que pararon si podían llevarnos a Coyhaique. 
Todos dijeron que no, y los coches que no pararon no quisieron parar junto a la policía.
Caminamos 300 metros por la carretera y nos recogieron en 10 minutos.
comments.textDe:
Als wir hier waren, gab es eine Polizeikontrolle. Die Polizei war nett und fragte die angehaltenen Autos, ob sie uns nach Coyhaique bringen könnten. 
Alle sagten nein, und die Autos, die sie nicht anhielten, wollten nicht neben der Polizei anhalten.
Wir gingen 300 Meter die Straße hinunter und wurden in 10 Minuten abgeholt
